fixed_statement:
Assume \(\{1,2,3\}\) is a flat of loops. The underlying matroid is
\[
U_{0,\{1,2,3\}}\oplus U_{2,4}.
\]
fixed_proof:
A flat of \(3\) loops leaves a rank \(2\) matroid on \(\{4,5,6,7\}\). The same flat calculation used for the remaining elements in Claim 4.2.2 applies on \(\{4,5,6,7\}\). Its rank \(1\) flats must be the four singletons, forcing the underlying matroid to be
\[
U_{0,\{1,2,3\}}\oplus U_{2,4}.
\]
